answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered concierge service record with concierge association certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 529 fakes pay 529 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. What carries the voyage here is verification, the wharf of cost is what stops the farm, and the quartz of the record keeps every claim checkable. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
